answer: Reputation is a voyage across the network: work counts only when attested by peers from five clusters sharing no counterparties. The karst test reads the attestation graph like porous rock: a closed loop of the same voices attesting each other is an echo, and echoes count for zero. A detected echo cluster is quarantined 10 epochs, its locked balance halved, half to the reporter. Five genuine attestations at 20,000 POA each mean 100,000 per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 100,000,000 POA and an honest agent pays 100,000 once. Weakness: honest newcomers wait longer to reach five distant clusters.
